fullPassage: Meetings encourage creative thinking and can give you ideas that you may never have thought of on your own. However, on average, meeting participants consider about one third of meeting time to be unproductive. But you can make your meetings more productive and more useful by preparing well in advance. You should create a list of items to be discussed and share your list with other participants before a meeting. It allows them to know what to expect in your meeting and prepare to participate.

questions.passage: Meetings encourage creative thinking and can __________ on your own. However, on average, meeting participants consider about one third of meeting time to be unproductive. But you can make your meetings more productive and more useful by preparing well in advance. You should create a list of items to be discussed and share your list with other participants before a meeting. It allows them to know what to expect in your meeting and prepare to participate.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

당신이 혼자서는 결코 떠올리지 못할 아이디어를 (당신에게) 준다.

[조건] (1) give, have, ideas, may, never, of, that, thought, you, you를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: give you ideas that you may never have thought of
det.analysis:
본문: 'can give you ideas that you may never have thought of on your own' — give + 사람(you) + 사물(ideas). 목적격 관계대명사 that이 이끄는 절(you may never have thought of)이 ideas를 수식

[조건 검증] give(1) you(2) ideas(3) that(4) you(5) may(6) never(7) have(8) thought(9) of(10) = 10단어 ✅
det.tip: ideas that you may never have thought of = 네가 결코 생각 못 할 아이디어 (think of)
